correctness.rationale: For x=a*u0+b*u1+w+z, im ad_x=(a+bT)R+span(w,Tw). A zero pencil has exact ranks 0,1,2 from cyclic eigenlines; a nonzero pencil is a unit or a single linear factor of T^n-1, yielding ranks n and n-1. Central factors and all ranges were independently checked, and full brute-force matrix ranks match in 8 fields and sizes. The nonpolynomiality follows rigorously by alternating fixed-prime extension degrees.
